title: You Gaze Upon The Wives Of Others,
summary: Restlessness is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip; you gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip; you gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.turn: Restlessness steadies when this soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to.
